productConcept.name: Fieldset
productConcept.tagline: Structure Your Observations. Trust Your Findings.
productConcept.description: Structured research data platform for observational science teams. Captures, validates, and makes queryable field observations — from first observation to final finding. Built for ecology, archaeology, hydrology, and any discipline where observation quality determines research integrity.
